question: What enduring commitment do Brahmā and Viṣṇu make toward the source of auspiciousness?
premises: The object is the cause of great auspiciousness
Brahmā and Viṣṇu express intent to worship
The worship is to be continual
inference: Brahmā and Viṣṇu commit to always worshipping the cause of great auspiciousness.
uncertainties: mahā+bhaṅgala+kāraṇam appears with unusual spelling; likely mahā+maṅgala+kāraṇam
plain_english: We two shall always worship that cause of great auspiciousness.
